parameters.name: MaterialIds
parameters.description:
The material IDs. These are media asset IDs, such as VideoId for videos, ImageId for images, and MediaId for auxiliary media assets. Separate multiple material IDs with commas (,).

To obtain material IDs, see [Search for media information](~~86044~~).

parameters.name: MaterialType
parameters.description:
The material type. Valid values:

- **video**: video.
- **audio**: audio-only.
- **image**: image.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the online editing project.
